_doc: مرز فایل‌های هر برنامه‌نویس (عامل ۱۲۸k). هر فایل گیت دقیقاً یک صاحب دارد. الگو: مسیر دقیق، یا پیشوند با /** ، یا الگوی fnmatch. طولانی‌ترین الگو برنده است. rare: مال همان نقش و قابل ویرایش، ولی فقط وقتی خوانده می‌شود که کار صریحاً به آن اشاره کند. فایل foo_test.py خودکار مال صاحب foo.py است. بعد از هر تغییر: python3 tools/agent_context/build.py

budget._note: core_max برای «هسته»؛ owned_source_max برای سورس فعال (بدون rare و تست)

roles.title: روتر، چت پنل و پوستهٔ پنل
roles.summary: مغز چت پنل (انتخاب ابزار، کارت تأیید، قفل نوبت)، صفحهٔ چت، و قاب مشترک پنل (app-shell، lib، ui، تم) که همهٔ صفحه‌ها رویش می‌نشینند.
roles.title_en: Router, panel chat and panel shell
roles.mission: Own the panel chat brain: one model call per turn picks a tool name; code extracts arguments; every write tool goes through a confirm card. Own the shared panel frame (app-shell, lib/api.ts, ui/, theme, Next config) that every page sits on.
gates: qa50 router battery 50/50 on two consecutive runs on the hub's parallel instance whenever router_service.py, turn_parse.py, router_embed.py, backend/app/data/router_*.json or the LLM env changes. You cannot run it (it needs the hub); ask X5 in talk-x5.md and wait for the result before asking for merge.
rules: The model only picks a tool NAME. Prices, text and targets come from the user's sentence via code. Never add free-form string arguments that the model fills.
Every tool in WRITE_TOOLS must create a confirm card; it runs only on a matching, unexpired confirmId.
router_intent_vectors.json is generated: change router_intents.json and run backend/scripts/refresh_router_intents.py (needs the bge-m3 embed service). Never hand-edit or read the vectors file.

frontend/lib/api.ts, components/ui/*, app-shell.tsx are used by every page: keep exported names and props backward compatible; a breaking change needs a note to every role that imports it (see 'Your contract').
Panel copy is Persian, right-to-left, Persian digits where the page already uses them.

roles.title: استودیو، تصویر و محتوای برند
roles.summary: کپشن و پست، ساخت و ویرایش تصویر و ویدیو، گارد بینایی، کمپین‌ها، انتشار در کانال‌ها، هویت برند، لندینگ و موتور تبلیغ خود سوزان.
roles.mission: Own content creation: studio chat (captions, posts, stories), still/scene image generation with the vision guard, cutout, compose to video, campaigns, publishing to channels, brand identity, the public landing/legal pages and the promo-engine.
gates: qa_image_battery (tools/qa_image_battery.py) green when image_provider_service.py, cloud_cutout_service.py or compose_pipeline.py changes. It spends real cloud money: ask the owner in talk-x2.md to run it; never run it yourself.
rules: Every cloud image or vision call goes through the AI budget gate (_image_budget_capped / llm._budget_capped). No new cloud call without it.
Never publish a real post or send to a real audience in tests or experiments; studio_publish_service calls are mocked in tests.
The vision guard rejects only on an explicit 'no'; keep first and second pass consistent.
Heavy work runs in the worker (SOZAN_WORKER=1, job_queue) or asyncio.to_thread; never block the API event loop.
promo-engine/, brand/, campaigns/ are Sozan's own marketing material: touch only when the task names them.

roles.title: کانال‌ها، پیام‌رسان‌ها، پیامک و آنبوردینگ
roles.summary: اتصال و تأیید کانال (اینستاگرام، تلگرام، واتساپ، Sendbox، Unipile)، دریافت پیام و رسانهٔ ورودی، poll، ارسال بیرونی، اسکن پیج برای کاتالوگ، پیامک و OTP پیامکی، هشدار تلگرام مالک. ورود فروشندهٔ تازه (برند، انتخاب کانال، شروع اسکن).
roles.mission: Own every connection to the outside messaging world: Instagram/Telegram/WhatsApp/Sendbox/Unipile connect and verify, inbound webhooks and polling, inbound media, outbound send, page scan into the catalog, SMS and SMS OTP, owner Telegram alerts, and the new-seller onboarding flow.
rules: Inbound customer messages are handed to the inbox only through inbox_service.inbound / handle_inbound (owner Y). Never answer customers from channel code.
Never message a real customer, send a real SMS or post to a real channel from tests or experiments: mock the HTTP client (channel_http) in tests.
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is the owner-alert bot only; the shared seller bot is TELEGRAM_HUB_BOT_TOKEN and is never polled for DMs.
Respect existing poll intervals and backoff (Instagram >= 30s, 3 failures -> 300s); never tighten them.
Webhook secrets and OAuth tokens never appear in logs, events, reports or test output.

roles.title: ساخت و ویرایش فروشگاه
roles.summary: سمت هاب ساخت ویترین (فراخوانی کارخانه، وضعیت بیلد، نقشهٔ nginx هر فروشگاه)، ویرایش زندهٔ فروشگاه (اکشن، verify، rollback، undo) و فضای کاری فروشگاه.
external: Factory CLI (owner C, outside the repo): `settings.factory_script` with `status --job-id <id>` and `start ... --detach`; the last stdout line is JSON. Job file `<fastpath>/jobs/<id>.json`. Do not change how you parse these without C's ack.

Storefront files the editor patches follow C's template: `lib/brand.ts`, `lib/nav.ts`, `app/brand-vars.css`, `public/brand-vars.css`, `public/storefront-flags.json`, `public/catalog.json`, `public/pages/*.json`, `public/images/hero.png`.
roles.mission: Own the hub side of storefront building (calling the factory, job status, per-shop nginx map) and live editing of a running storefront: intent -> actions -> patch -> publish -> verify -> rollback, one-step undo, and the shop workspace.
gates: Edits must be tried on the test shop azmaish-panl (test account) before any live shop, and only after the owner says go in talk-x4.md.
rules: Never trigger a full rebuild ('دوباره بساز') of a real seller's live storefront; only reviseOnly updates.
A rolled-back turn must leave the build directory byte-identical to before: restore changed files, delete files the turn created, restore hero.png, remove .sozan-turn-*.
Never block the API event loop: factory calls go through asyncio.to_thread or read the job file directly.
The factory CLI and job JSON format belong to C; the patched storefront files (lib/brand.ts, lib/nav.ts, public/*.json ...) follow C's template. Ask C before assuming a new file layout.
The model never writes TSX: edit_llm returns JSON actions that go through the same patchers and verify.

roles.title: پلتفرم، حساب، اشتراک و انتشار
roles.summary: هستهٔ مشترک (LLM، state و مستأجر، observe، بودجهٔ ابر، config/main)، ورود و OTP، پلن و پرداخت اشتراک و کیف، مدیر هاب و پشتیبانی، استقرار روی هاب و CI. تنها کسی که روی هاب منتشر می‌کند.
external: observe service on the home machine (`POST {observe}/sozan/events`) and the LLM proxy; the event envelope (`pipeline_release.envelope`) is a contract for every role.

Batteries run on the hub's parallel instance (port 8013): `tools/qa50_battery.py` for X1, `tools/sales100_battery.py --live` for Y. You run them on request and append the one-line summary to the requester's report file.
roles.mission: Own the shared core every role depends on (LLM routing and calls, tenant state, locks, observe events, AI budget, config, app startup), login/OTP, plans, subscription payments and wallet, hub admin, settings, CI, and deployment. You are the only role that deploys to the hub.
gates: Before every deploy: full backend suite green (deploy/deploy-api.sh runs it with STATE_DIR and SOZAN_OBSERVE_OUTBOX=0). Deploy only with the owner's explicit go.
rules: Deploy only under the lock: flock /home/ubuntu/.sozan-deploy.lock with deploy/deploy-api.sh or deploy/deploy-panel.sh. Deploy from git (a merged main), never from a dirty tree.

state_store, tenant_lock, llm, observe_client, config are imported by every role: never rename or change the signature of anything listed in 'Your contract' without a request in each affected role's report file first.
Tenant isolation: every read/write goes through state_store with the tenant ContextVar; background threads must copy the context (contextvars.copy_context()).
The AI budget gate stays fail-open on internal errors but must emit budget-check-failed; never remove the company daily cap.
Run the batteries other roles ask for (qa50, sales100 live) on the hub's parallel instance and append the summary line to the requester's report file.

roles.title: فروشندهٔ خودکار (دایرکت) و دادهٔ آموزش
roles.summary: صندوق و پاسخ خودکار، عامل دایرکت (ابزار stock/order/payment_link، گارد عدد و ادعا)، سیاست فروش، حافظهٔ مشتری و Chroma، ماسک PII، لحن برند، و هستهٔ دادهٔ فاین‌تیون.
external: Chroma (not installed yet; `deploy/sozan-chroma.service`). Database key only from `memory_key()`.
`/settings/sales-policy` in `backend/app/api/settings.py` (owner X5) saves your sales-policy form; change its shape only with X5.
roles.title_en: Automated seller (DM agent) and training data
roles.mission: Own the DM inbox and the agent that answers customers: auto-reply modes, the tool loop (stock, order_status, payment_link), number/claim guards, sales policy, customer memory, Chroma shop memory, PII masking, brand tone, and the core of the fine-tune data pipeline.
gates: Any change to inbox_agent_service.py, inbox_service.py, sales_policy_service.py, claims_guard.py or pii_mask.py: sales100 100/100 on two consecutive live runs on the parallel instance (sales-agent-plan.md §3.7). 99/100 means no merge. Ask X5 to run it.
Offline structure check you can run: python3 tools/sales100_battery.py (must print 'sales100 structure 101/101').
rules: Every price, stock count, order status and payment link comes from a tool result in the same turn; the number guard must reject anything else, including '۱٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰' and 'یک و نیم میلیون' forms.
Customer text passes pii_mask before any cloud model; training examples only with consent (training_log.consent_enabled) and never from source='voice'.
At most one successful payment_link per customer turn; never a link for an out-of-stock item or qty above stock.
No real customer message, real payment or real post in tests: use the test tenant and the dry gateway (edge_dry).
Chroma database key comes only from memory_key(); never from user or model input.

roles.title: دستیار صوتی تلفن
roles.summary: گیت‌وی SIP و RTP، STT/TTS، مغز تماس (پشتیبانی و فروش)، ماشین حالت فروش، شبیه‌ساز و ارزیابی، کمپین تماس.
external: HTTP to the hub: `GET {SOZAN_API}/billing/plans` (plan prices; owner X5, `backend/app/api/billing.py`) and `GET {SOZAN_API}/health` (field `paymentReady`; owner X5, `backend/app/main.py`). If either fails, say no price.
llama-swap on the home machine: only the `ornith-phone` slot, plus `/v1/audio/speech` and `/v1/embeddings` (bge-m3, read-only use).
DNC file `~/local-ai/config/sozan-dnc.txt`; call log `~/local-ai/sozan-voice-log/calls.jsonl` (mode 600, stays on that machine).
roles.mission: Own the phone line end to end: SIP/RTP gateway, STT/TTS, the support and sales call brain, the sales state machine, simulators and evaluation, and outbound call campaigns.
gates: Any change to the sales flow (sales.py, brain.py, meaning.py, knowledge.py): simulated calls on the home machine (needs llama-swap and STT) for the personas the task touches, e.g. `cd voice-gateway && python3 sim_run.py p01`, plus the acceptance condition (شرط قبولی) of the voice-agent-plan.md section you are working on.
loopback_test.py places a real local SIP call against a running gateway: run it only on the home machine with the phone service up and no live call in progress.
rules: No real call without the owner's permission; campaign_run.py --dial only after the owner writes 'شروع کمپین' in voice-agent-talk.md. Test with sim_run.py / sim_call.py.
DNC is sacred: 'زنگ نزنید' or similar -> number written to the DNC file immediately, never called again; keep its test.
Calls only inside campaign windows (currently 10-13 and 16-20 Tehran) with the daily cap and spacing in campaign_run.py.
Honesty: if asked, it is 'دستیار صوتی سوزان', never a human; no invented prices, codes or claims. Prices come only from GET /billing/plans.

GPU: only Vulkan1 and the ornith-phone slot and sozan-voice* units are yours. Never restart llama-swap or touch qwen3.5-9b, bge-m3 or other slots. Restart the phone service only when no call is in progress.
Never write a caller's number or words into a report; counts, times and call ids only.
Git (voice-agent-plan.md §0.9): work on feat/voice-z; rebase on a fresh main and merge only after tests and the stage's acceptance condition pass; do not push to origin unless the owner says so.

roles.title: ویترین، کاتالوگ، سفارش مشتری، دامنه، پشتیبانی و پایش
roles.summary: هر چه به سایت زندهٔ فروشگاه و مشتری‌اش برمی‌گردد: کاتالوگ و موجودی، همگام‌سازی با ویترین، سفارش و پرداخت مشتری (/p/)، دامنه و DNS آروان، تنظیمات فروشگاه، تیکت پشتیبانی، و بیرون از مخزن: کارخانه، قالب‌ها و پایش.
external: Main work outside the repo: `/home/demon/local-ai/smoke-workspace/site-builder/**` (templates, quality gate, `tools/sozan_factory_fastpath.py`). X4 reads the `status` JSON and the job file: their fields are a contract.
The live storefront calls these hub routes, all yours: `/p/catalog-ids`, `/p/shop-config`, `/p/shop/checkout`, `/p/shop/paid`, `/p/otp/*`, `/p/tickets`, `/catalog/*`.
`tools/monitor/**` and `tools/storefront/**` live on branch `feat/storefront-c`; after merge they are yours automatically.
roles.title_en: Storefronts, catalog, customer orders, domains, support, monitoring
roles.mission: Own everything about a seller's live storefront and its customers: catalog and stock, sync to the storefront, customer orders and payment (/p/), receipts, custom domains and Arvan DNS, shop settings, support tickets; and outside the repo the factory, templates, quality gate and monitoring.
gates: Template or factory changes: tried on the test shop azmaish-panl first and checked at 390px and 1440px widths before touching any live shop.
rules: Never delete or rewrite a real seller's catalog, orders or shop data. Never run a full rebuild on a live storefront; template updates must not touch the catalog.
Customer payments: test only with the dry gateway (edge_dry) or the test account; never a real charge.
DNS: changes only through arvan_dns_service; the dns-watch self-heal is the only automatic DNS write allowed.
Monitoring is read-only: no automatic restart or repair (except the DNS self-heal); no customer or seller text, phone numbers or keys in metrics, alerts or the status page.
Factory CLI output (status JSON, job file) is read by X4: keep its fields stable or announce changes in talk-x4.md.

roles.title: مالک و برنامه‌ریز (برنامه‌نویس نیست)
roles.summary: پلن‌ها، قواعد تیم، سندهای مرجع و ابزار ویرایشگر. برنامه‌نویس‌ها فقط می‌خوانند، آن هم وقتی پلنشان ارجاع داده.
roles.mission: Plans, team rules and reference docs.
